minutes.headline: Select Board renewed earth removal permits, set a Nov 15 special town meeting, and will ask the APDC to rehear Ritter windows.
minutes.summary: The Select Board, with a guest chair in place of the regular chair, handled permit renewals, appointments, and dates for a special town meeting. It gave the Finance Committee access to town counsel for drafting a bylaw, assigned police to polling places under the new VOTES Act, and authorized the town manager to ask the architectural preservation district commission to rehear the Ritter building window denial.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted unanimously to authorize the town manager to ask the architectural preservation district commission to rehear the Ritter building window denial.
The board approved a special town meeting for November 15, 2022 at 7 pm, with the warrant opening August 23 and closing September 20.
The board approved the Finance Committee's request for access to town counsel, with a draft condition, passing unanimously.
The board renewed six earth removal permits for 12 months and a seventh permit separately for the Proctors.
The board voted to assign at least one police officer to each polling location under the new VOTES Act, with the police chief assigning them.

why_it_matters: The window rehearing and the open override placeholder for the special town meeting warrant could put a spending question before voters on November 15.
Town counsel help for the Finance Committee's bylaw drafting is covered by the town's existing retainer, per the minutes, so it adds no separate cost.
Election officers and police at polling places affect how the elections budget is spent, which registrars described as stretched thin.
watch_next: The August 23 meeting, when the special town meeting warrant opens and a 300th anniversary committee charge draft is due.
The September 20 5 pm warrant closing, and the November 15, 2022 special town meeting at 7 pm.
